components.text: Several terms have precise meanings throughout the manual. Knowing them makes logs, packets, and compiler diagnostics much easier to read.

pages.text:
• Glyph: one connected shape extracted from canvas pixels.
• Boundary: an outer-circle glyph that scopes inner content.
• CenterSymbol: the center behavior or type of an array.

• ParameterRune: a parameter supplied to a center or compiler.
• OpInput: a rune, compiled operation, or raw child array seen by the compiler.

• CompiledOp: an executable node with a boundary, inputs, and runtime behavior.
• ArrayObject: the server-side live array and its reverse indexes.
